name: HanchorBio Inc.
summary: HanchorBio Inc. engages in the research and development of new anti-cancer drugs in Hong Kong and Mainland China. The companys product pipeline consists of HCB101, which is in phase II clinical trial to treat head and neck cancer, triple-negative breast cancer, gastric cancer, colorectal cancer, and small cell lung cancer; HCB301, which is in phase I clinical trial for the treatment of hematologic malignancies, head and neck cancer, and solid tumors; and HCB303, which is in preclinical trial to treat hematologic malignancies, head and neck cancer, and solid tumors. Its technology is the Fc-Based Designer Biologics platform, which focuses on the development of next-generation immuno-oncology …
